items.title: CVE-2026-48907: Joomla Content Editor (JCE) extension for Joomla remote code execution in editor profile management (Update: proof of concept on GitHub published)
items.summary: Update: proof of concept on GitHub published. The Joomla Content Editor (JCE) extension for Joomla has a flaw that lets an attacker create new editor profiles, upload PHP code, and run it on the server, and this can be done remotely without logging in. The vulnerability is listed in CISA's Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog, which means it is being used in attacks.

items.title: CVE-2026-34197: Apache ActiveMQ Broker remote code execution in Jolokia MBeans (Update: proof of concept on GitHub published)
items.summary: Update: proof of concept on GitHub published. Apache ActiveMQ (including the Broker and All packages) lets an attacker who can log in with a low-privilege account run arbitrary code on the broker's Java process. They reach it remotely over the network through the web console's Jolokia endpoint, by making the broker load a remote Spring XML configuration. This bug is listed as exploited in attacks by CISA's Known Exploited Vulnerabilities c...

items.title: CVE-2023-32315: Openfire authentication bypass in admin console via path traversal (Update: proof of concept on GitHub published)
items.summary: Update: proof of concept on GitHub published. Openfire, an XMPP server from igniterealtime, has a flaw in its web-based Admin Console that lets an attacker bypass authentication and reach restricted administrator pages by using path traversal through the setup environment. The attacker can do this remotely, without logging in, and the bug is listed in CISA's Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog, meaning attacks are happening.

items.title: CVE-2026-133311: Mitel MiCollab authentication bypass in AWV conferencing component (Update: added to CISA KEV)
items.summary: Update: added to CISA KEV. A vulnerability in the Audio, Web, and Video Conferencing (AWV) component of Mitel MiCollab could let an unauthenticated attacker remotely, without logging in, get past improper authentication if they know a specific system-generated random identifier or pre-staged content, and so obtain sensitive information. The flaw is limited to the affected functionality and does not give unrestricted acce...

items.title: CVE-2026-133324: Mitel MiCollab authentication bypass in AWV conferencing (Update: added to CISA KEV)
items.summary: Update: added to CISA KEV. A vulnerability in the Audio, Web, and Video Conferencing (AWV) component of Mitel MiCollab could allow an attacker to bypass authentication and perform unauthorized actions within the application. The attacker can do this remotely, without logging in.

items.title: CVE-2026-59310: VMware remote code execution via path traversal in syslog server (Update: Nuclei template published)
items.summary: Update: Nuclei template published. A directory traversal flaw in the Syslog server of VMware vCenter (also affecting VMware Cloud Foundation, vSphere Foundation, Telco Cloud Infrastructure and Telco Cloud Platform) lets an attacker run arbitrary code on vCenter. It can be reached remotely over the network without logging in, and the bug is listed in CISA's Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog, meaning attacks are happening.

items.title: CVE-2025-41450: Danfoss AK-SM 8xxA Series authentication bypass in login grants privileged access (Update: added to CISA KEV)
items.summary: Update: added to CISA KEV. Danfoss AK-SM 8xxA Series devices have an improper authentication flaw that lets an attacker bypass login and gain privileged access, reachable remotely without logging in, though a user must take some action such as clicking a link. This bug is listed by CISA as exploited in attacks.

items.title: CVE-2026-133469: Xen Orchestra remote authentication bypass in REST API login tokens (Update: added to CISA KEV)
items.summary: Update: added to CISA KEV. Xen Orchestra (including its xo-server component) has a flaw in how its REST API handles login tokens. A remote attacker without a login can authenticate as the owner of an unexpired login token. The attacker can then retrieve reusable login token IDs for that account.

items.title: CVE-2026-133323: Mitel MiCollab unauthenticated command execution in AWV component (Update: added to CISA KEV)
items.summary: Update: added to CISA KEV. A vulnerability in the Audio, Web, and Video Conferencing (AWV) component of Mitel MiCollab could let an unauthenticated attacker run arbitrary commands on the system through a blind command injection caused by insufficient parameter sanitization. It can be reached remotely over the network, without logging in.

items.title: CVE-2026-133275: Mitel MiCollab unauthenticated file upload in AWV conferencing (Update: added to CISA KEV)
items.summary: Update: added to CISA KEV. A flaw in the Audio, Web, and Video Conferencing (AWV) component of Mitel MiCollab lets an unauthenticated attacker upload arbitrary files to the affected system because file types are not checked properly. The attack can be launched remotely over the network without logging in.

items.title: CVE-2026-133303: Mitel MiCollab unauthenticated command execution in AWV conferencing (Update: added to CISA KEV)
items.summary: Update: added to CISA KEV. Mitel MiCollab's Audio, Web, and Video Conferencing (AWV) component does not sufficiently validate parameters, which lets an unauthenticated attacker remotely, without logging in, use pre-staged malicious content to inject XML. A successful attack could allow arbitrary commands to be run within the context of the system.

items.title: CVE-2026-133335
items.summary: Joomla Extension - virtuemart.net - Unauthenticated local file inclusion leading to remote code execution via controller fallback in VirtueMart extension 4.0.0-4.8.7 - The main controller of the component fell back to including a controller file derived from the request without filtering the name, allowing path traversal to arbitrary local PHP files. Depending on the server setup, for example an available pearcmd.php, this could be used to execute code. The issue has been exploited in the wild. Fixed in 4.8.8.

items.title: CVE-2019-15107: Remote command execution in password change page (Update: proof of concept on GitHub published)
items.summary: Update: proof of concept on GitHub published. Webmin has a command injection flaw in its password change page (the "old" parameter in password_change.cgi) that lets an attacker run arbitrary commands on the server with root privileges. It can be reached remotely, without logging in, and attacks are happening because the bug is listed in CISA's Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog.

items.title: CVE-2025-2611: ICT Innovations ICTBroadcast remote code execution in session cookie handling (Update: now rated critical)
items.summary: Update: now rated critical. ICTBroadcast by ICT Innovations passes session cookie data unsafely to shell processing, so an attacker can inject shell commands into a session cookie and run them on the server. The attack can be carried out remotely over the network without logging in, and public exploit code, including a Metasploit module, is available.

items.title: CVE-2022-44384: rconfig remote code execution via file upload handler (Update: now rated critical)
items.summary: Update: now rated critical. An arbitrary file upload flaw in rconfig lets a remote attacker with a low-privilege login upload a crafted PHP file and run arbitrary code on the server. Public exploit code, including a Metasploit module, is available.

items.title: CVE-2025-25034: SugarCRM PHP Deserialization RCE (Update: now rated critical)
items.summary: Update: now rated critical. SugarCRM is affected by a PHP object injection flaw that lets a remote attacker run arbitrary code within the application, without logging in and without any user action. Public exploit code, including a Metasploit module, is available.

items.title: CVE-2026-119618: Apache HTTP Server remote code execution in mod_http2 via race condition (Update: Metasploit module published)
items.summary: Update: Metasploit module published. Apache HTTP Server's mod_http2 module has a race condition in its assign_headers() routine that can corrupt heap memory. A remote attacker who can reach the server without logging in can exploit it to run arbitrary commands on the server, take control of the server process, and access or modify sensitive information. Public exploit code exists for this flaw.

items.title: CVE-2019-17382: Zabbix authentication bypass in dashboard page (Update: proof of concept on GitHub published)
items.summary: Update: proof of concept on GitHub published. Zabbix has a flaw that lets a remote attacker bypass the login page without logging in, then create dashboards, reports, screens, or maps. Other users and administrators can then access these items. Public exploit code is available.

items.title: CVE-2015-10141: Xdebug unauthenticated command injection in remote debugger (Update: now rated critical)
items.summary: Update: now rated critical. Xdebug, a PHP debugging extension, has an unauthenticated command injection flaw in its remote debugger, which listens on port 9000 when remote debugging is enabled. A remote attacker without a login can send a crafted eval command to run arbitrary PHP code, including system commands, gaining full control of the host with the web server user's privileges, and public exploit code is available.

items.title: CVE-2026-20182: Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Controller authentication bypass in fabric management plane (Update: proof of concept on GitHub published)
items.summary: Update: proof of concept on GitHub published. Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Controller and Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Manager have an authentication bypass flaw that lets an attacker over the network, without logging in, sign in as an internal high-privileged user and use NETCONF to change the SD-WAN fabric's network configuration. Public exploit code, including a Metasploit module, is available, and the bug is being exploited in attacks.

items.title: CVE-2026-24061: GNU Inetutils remote authentication bypass in telnetd (Update: proof of concept on GitHub published)
items.summary: Update: proof of concept on GitHub published. The telnetd service in GNU Inetutils can be tricked into logging an attacker in as root without a password, because it passes an unchecked USER value to the login program, which treats it as a command option. An attacker can do this remotely, without logging in, by connecting to a reachable telnetd server. Public exploit code exists, and the bug is being exploited in attacks.

items.title: CVE-2026-132694 | Wikimedia MediaWiki up to 1.46.2/1.47 OATHAuth src/Key/WebAuthnKey.php privilege escalation (Nessus ID 386110)
items.summary: A vulnerability, which was classified as critical , has been found in Wikimedia MediaWiki up to 1.46.2/1.47 . This vulnerability affects unknown code of the file src/Key/WebAuthnKey.php of the component OATHAuth . This manipulation causes privilege escalation. The identification of this vulnerability is CVE-2026-132694 . It is possible to initiate the attack remotely. There is no exploit available. It is advisable to upgrade the affected component.

items.title: CVE-2026-103406: Juniper Session Smart Conductor unauthenticated command execution in AutomatedProvisioner (Update: proof of concept on GitHub published)
items.summary: Update: proof of concept on GitHub published. Juniper Networks Session Smart Conductor is affected, specifically its AutomatedProvisioner component. An unauthenticated remote attacker could exploit this flaw to run arbitrary commands with root privileges on the system.

items.title: CVE-2017-9841: PHPUnit remote code execution in eval-stdin.php script (Update: proof of concept on GitHub published)
items.summary: Update: proof of concept on GitHub published. PHPUnit, a widely used testing framework for PHP, is affected by this vulnerability. An attacker can remotely run arbitrary PHP code on a server if its vendor folder is publicly accessible, potentially giving them full control of the affected system.

items.title: CVE-2024-36401: GeoServer remote code execution in property name evaluation (Update: proof of concept on GitHub published)
items.summary: Update: proof of concept on GitHub published. GeoServer, the open source server for sharing and editing geospatial data, has a flaw that lets an attacker run arbitrary code on the host by sending crafted request parameters, remotely and without logging in. It affects default installations through web requests such as WFS, WMS and WPS calls, and the bug is listed as exploited in attacks by CISA.

items.title: CVE-2017-12615: Apache Tomcat remote code execution via file upload in default servlet (Update: proof of concept on GitHub published)
items.summary: Update: proof of concept on GitHub published. Apache Tomcat, a widely used web server for Java applications, is affected when run on Windows with HTTP PUT requests enabled. An attacker could upload a malicious JSP file through a specially crafted request, allowing the attacker's code to run on the server.

items.title: CVE-2012-1823: PHP remote code execution in the CGI binary (Update: proof of concept on GitHub published)
items.summary: Update: proof of concept on GitHub published. The PHP interpreter when run as a CGI program (php-cgi) is affected, along with any web server setup that uses it to handle requests. An attacker who sends a specially crafted request with command-line options in the query string could run arbitrary code on the server.

items.title: CVE-2014-6271: Remote code execution in environment variable parsing (Update: proof of concept on GitHub published)
items.summary: Update: proof of concept on GitHub published. GNU Bash, the common Linux and Unix command shell, runs extra commands hidden after a function definition in an environment variable's value. A remote attacker can use this to run shell commands and take over a system, without logging in, whenever a service such as an SSH, web server CGI or DHCP client setup passes attacker-controlled environment variables to Bash. This flaw is listed as exploi...

items.title: CVE-2024-27198: JetBrains TeamCity auth bypass in server login allows admin actions (Update: proof of concept on GitHub published)
items.summary: Update: proof of concept on GitHub published. JetBrains TeamCity has an authentication bypass flaw that lets an attacker perform administrator actions on the server. It can be exploited remotely over the network without logging in, and it is being used in attacks.

items.title: CVE-2018-14847: Unauthenticated file read in WinBox interface (Update: proof of concept on GitHub published)
items.summary: Update: proof of concept on GitHub published. MikroTik RouterOS has a directory traversal flaw in its WinBox interface that lets an attacker connect to the Winbox port remotely, without logging in, and read the system user database file, which exposes router credentials including plain text passwords. CISA lists this bug as exploited in attacks.

items.title: CVE-2023-43208: Unauthenticated code execution via command injection (Update: proof of concept on GitHub published)
items.summary: Update: proof of concept on GitHub published. NextGen Healthcare Mirth Connect has a flaw that lets an attacker run their own code on the server remotely, without logging in, which could be used to gain initial access or to compromise sensitive healthcare data. On Windows the code typically runs with the highest system privileges, and the bug is being exploited in attacks.

items.title: CVE-2023-25915: Danfoss AK-SM800A remote command execution via input validation (Update: added to CISA KEV)
items.summary: Update: added to CISA KEV. Danfoss AK-SM800A has an input validation flaw that lets an attacker run arbitrary commands on the device. The attacker can reach it remotely over the network with only a low-privilege login and no user interaction, and the bug is listed as exploited in attacks by CISA.

items.title: CVE-2023-25914: Danfoss AK-SM800A authenticated path traversal in XML interface (Update: added to CISA KEV)
items.summary: Update: added to CISA KEV. Danfoss AK-SM800A has a path traversal flaw in its XML interface that lets an attacker with a low-privilege login read system files on the underlying server, which could lead to a full system compromise. It can be reached remotely over the network with no user interaction, and it is being exploited in attacks.

items.title: CVE-2026-126735 | Drupal Campaign Monitor Module up to 3.0.2 cross-site request forgery
items.summary: A vulnerability, which was classified as problematic , has been found in Drupal Campaign Monitor Module up to 3.0.2 . Affected is an unknown function. items.title: BerriAI LiteLLM Guardrail Sandbox Escape RCE
items.summary: What is the Vulnerability? CVE-2026-40217 is a critical arbitrary-code-execution vulnerability in BerriAI LiteLLM, a widely used open-source LLM proxy/gateway. LiteLLM's guardrail feature includes a "test custom code" facility that runs user-supplied guardrail code in a sandbox. The sandbox can be escaped by rewriting Python bytecode, allowing an attacker to break out and execute arbitrary code in the context of the LiteLLM process (reported running as root in some deployments). The vector is a request to POST /guardrails/test_custom_code. CVSS is 8.8- the attacker needs minimal low-privilege…

items.title: CVE-2026-95796
items.summary: A vulnerability in the web-based management interface of HPE Networking Management Software (Airwave) could allow an unauthenticated remote attacker to conduct a reflected cross-site scripting (XSS) attack against a user of the interface. Successful exploitation could allow an attacker to execute arbitrary script code in a victim's browser in the context of the web interface.

items.summary: The ADDRESSYA WordPress plugin through 3.1.1 does not have authorisation and CSRF checks when saving its service credentials, and does not escape them when outputting them in an admin page, allowing unauthenticated users to perform Stored Cross-Site Scripting attacks against administrators.

items.summary: Update: now rated critical. The LearnPress WordPress LMS plugin, from thimpress, has a command injection flaw in its get_content function. Remotely and without logging in, an attacker can call any public function with a single parameter, which could lead to remote code execution.

items.summary: Update: now rated critical. Trend Micro ServerProtect for Storage, for Microsoft Windows / Novell NetWare, for EMC Celerra, and for Network Appliance Filers contain integer overflow conditions that a remote attacker can reach over the network without logging in or any user action. Exploiting them could crash the process or allow remote code execution.

The attacker can reach it remotely over the network, but must first obtain valid credentials on the system.

Remote attackers without logging in can run arbitrary shell commands with web server privileges by sending commands in the 'password' POST parameter of login.php and index.php.

items.summary: Update: now rated critical. Because the attacker can combine this with a root-level interpreter on the device, they could gain full control of the system.

items.summary: Loginizer before 2.1.4 contains a brute-force lockout bypass vulnerability in loginizer_login_failed() that allows unauthenticated attackers to avoid failed-attempt recording via non-ASCII URL bytes. Attackers can append invalid UTF-8 or 4-byte sequences to wp-login.php or xmlrpc.php request URLs, causing the log INSERT to fail and enabling unlimited password guessing without lockout or email notification.

items.title: CVE-2026-114507
items.summary: LightRAG provides simple and fast retrieval-augmented generation. Prior to 1.5.5, query responses are cached under a key that omits conversation_history, so an unauthenticated attacker can poison the cached answers returned to other users who send the same query. This issue is fixed in version 1.5.5.

items.title: CVE-2026-115576
items.summary: NetBird is a zero-trust networking platform that connects people, machines, and AI agents across any network. From versions 0.5.0 through 0.75.1, the client daemon exposes its gRPC control interface to any local process without authentication. On Linux, macOS, and FreeBSD, the interface is a Unix domain socket that is accessible to all local users, allowing any of them to control the daemon. An attacker with a low-privilege account can read or modify privileged VPN and daemon settings, disconnect or hijack the NetBird peer, and gain an unauthenticated root shell via the built-in SSH server. Th…

items.title: CVE-2026-137084
items.summary: NodeBB 4.12.0 before 4.16.4 contains an execution after redirect vulnerability in the Intents.create controller that allows unauthenticated attackers to trigger ActivityPub note ingestion. Attackers can send GET requests to /intents/create with a remote note URI in the toPid parameter to inject federated content as local topics and posts.

items.title: CVE-2026-137064
items.summary: Chatwoot before 4.20.0 contains a missing authentication vulnerability in the Bandwidth SMS webhook endpoint POST /webhooks/sms/:phone_number that allows unauthenticated attackers to submit forged SMS events. Attackers who know an inbox phone number can set the 'to' field to inject inbound messages with forged sender numbers or forge delivery status updates.

items.title: CVE-2026-137059
items.summary: ToolJet from 3.16.0 before 3.20.256 contains an improper signature verification vulnerability in StripeWebhookGuard that validates webhooks against a self-generated signature instead of the Stripe-Signature header. Unauthenticated attackers can post forged Stripe events to the POST /api/organization/payment/webhooks route to activate subscriptions, generate licenses, change plans or seats, and add AI credits without payment.

items.title: CVE-2026-137058
items.summary: Cron-parser through 5.10.0 contains an unbounded memory allocation vulnerability in CronExpressionParser.parse() that allows unauthenticated attackers to exhaust memory by supplying oversized cron fields. Attackers can submit a roughly 1.6 MB expression of repeated wildcard tokens that expand into huge arrays, exhausting the V8 heap and crashing the Node.js process.

items.title: CVE-2026-137057
items.summary: llama.cpp from b7118 before b12604 contains an integer underflow vulnerability in llama_grammar_parser::parse_sequence() that allows unauthenticated remote attackers to cause denial of service by supplying GBNF repetitions with max lower than min. Attackers can send a grammar like {5,2} in the grammar field of a llama-server /completion request, wrapping n_opt to generate endless repetition rules that hang the process and exhaust memory.

items.title: CVE-2026-81418
items.summary: Nmap before 7.992 contains an uncontrolled resource consumption vulnerability in the TLV.AUTH parser of the NSE eigrp.lua library, whose length arithmetic cancels out the running read position. An attacker on the same layer 2 segment can send a single crafted EIGRP Update of roughly 36 bytes over unauthenticated multicast, causing unbounded table growth that exhausts the memory of the Nmap process when broadcast-eigrp-discovery.nse is running.

items.title: CVE-2026-77230
items.summary: Camunda 8.8.0 before 8.8.47, 8.9.0 before 8.9.29, 8.10.0 before 8.10.10, and 8.11.0-alpha1 contain an insecure deserialization vulnerability in the persistent web session feature, which stores session attributes as Java-serialized data in secondary storage and deserializes them via an ObjectInputStream without an ObjectInputFilter. Attackers with write access to the web session index, such as an unauthenticated Elasticsearch cluster deployed via Camunda's docker-compose files, can plant a crafted serialized object and trigger deserialization by presenting a matching session cookie, which combi…

items.title: CVE-2026-135228
items.summary: A vulnerability in the MongoDB integration package for the Laravel framework allows an unauthorized user to bypass mass assignment attribute protections. When an application uses attribute deny-lists to guard sensitive model fields, specially crafted request payloads containing database operator keys can circumvent these protections. An unauthorized user with network access to an affected application endpoint can modify guarded attributes, potentially leading to privilege escalation within the application

items.title: CVE-2026-81419
items.summary: Nmap before 7.992 contains an infinite loop vulnerability in the LSUpdate.parse function of the NSE ospf.lua library, which does not advance when it reads an LSA header with a zero length. An attacker on the same layer 2 segment can send a single spoofed, unauthenticated OSPF LS Update packet, causing a permanent 100% CPU hang of the Nmap process as soon as broadcast-ospf2-discover.nse captures it.

items.title: CVE-2026-82489
items.summary: openIMIS before 2026-10 contains an unauthenticated remote code execution vulnerability in the report module (openimis-be-report_py) where the /api/report/reportbro/preview endpoint evaluates printIf expressions server-side using simpleeval with an insufficient name-prefix blocklist. An attacker can craft an expression that reaches sys.modules['os'] via datetime.sys to execute arbitrary operating-system commands as root, and can also exploit the same endpoint's key parameter for unauthenticated arbitrary file read, enabling full host compromise including exposure of database credentials and JW…

items.title: CVE-2026-82493
items.summary: openIMIS before 2026-10 contains a remote code execution vulnerability in the report module's overrideReport GraphQL mutation, which stores submitted report definitions without proper validation before rendering them with the simpleeval expression evaluator. An attacker holding only limited report add, edit, or query privileges can craft a printIf expression that leverages the datetime module to reach os.system functions, bypassing the name-prefix blocklist to execute arbitrary operating-system commands as root whenever the malicious report is later rendered by any viewer, including administra…

items.title: CVE-2026-81336
items.summary: GitLab has remediated an issue in GitLab CE/EE affecting all versions from 12.8 before 19.4.11, 19.5 before 19.5.9, and 19.6 before 19.6.2 that could have allowed an unauthenticated user to execute quick actions through Service Desk emails due to improper input sanitization.

items.title: CVE-2026-132102
items.summary: GitLab has remediated an issue in GitLab CE/EE affecting all versions from 14.4 before 19.4.11, 19.5 before 19.5.9, and 19.6 before 19.6.2 that under certain conditions could have allowed an unauthenticated user to cause denial of service due to unconstrained backtracking in regular expression evaluation.

items.title: CVE-2026-135402
items.summary: Ever Gauzy is an open source business management platform for ERP, CRM, HRM, ATS, and project management. Prior to 111.42.13, POST /api/integration/github/webhook in packages/plugins/integration-github/src/lib/probot/probot.discovery.ts passes request bodies through ProbotDiscovery.receiveHook to probot.receive without verifying x-hub-signature-256 against the configured webhook secret. Because the route is public and uses the attacker-controlled installation.id to locate integrations, an unauthenticated remote attacker who knows or guesses an installation identifier can forge installation del…

items.title: CVE-2026-132888
items.summary: A flaw was found in librelp. When configured to use Transport Layer Security (TLS) with certificate validation and the GnuTLS driver, the library fails to verify the peer certificate chain. A remote, unauthenticated attacker can exploit this issue by presenting an invalid or self-signed certificate, allowing them to bypass authentication and act as a trusted log source or collector.

items.title: CVE-2026-136916
items.summary: HortusFox (hortusfox-web) through 6.4 contains a password reset poisoning vulnerability in UserModel::restorePassword that builds reset links from the client-controlled Host header. Unauthenticated attackers can request a reset with a forged Host header to capture the victim's reset token and take over accounts including administrators.

items.title: CVE-2026-136915
items.summary: HortusFox through 6.4 contains an information exposure vulnerability in BackupModule::start that allows unauthenticated attackers to download workspace backups stored in the public/backup directory. Attackers can enumerate one-second-precision creation timestamps used as filenames to retrieve archives containing locations, plants, gallery, tasks, inventory and calendar data.

items.title: CVE-2026-136912
items.summary: Paid Memberships Pro before 3.8.8 contains an information disclosure vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to read restricted post excerpts because restriction is reapplied only through the_excerpt filter. Attackers can request RSS or Atom feeds, oEmbed URLs, or pages rendering the Post Excerpt block to read opening text or manual excerpts of member-only posts.

items.title: CVE-2026-135227
items.summary: An improper restriction of dynamically determined object attributes in the object-document mapping library's association handling allows structured input supplied in place of a simple identifier value to be turned into an object that is treated as an already-stored record of a caller-chosen model class. In applications that pass unfiltered request data into the affected association handling, an unauthenticated party may cause unintended modification or removal of stored records, and may render an individual record unreadable through that association.

items.title: CVE-2026-135226
items.summary: A type-confusion weakness in the Extended JSON parsing component of BSON for Ruby allows a party who can supply parser input to influence how a serialized document is framed. Content placed in one value may be read back as additional or replacement document fields. An unauthenticated party supplying input to an application that parses untrusted Extended JSON and stores the result may cause unintended modification of stored data.

items.title: CVE-2026-135898
items.summary: An out-of-bounds read in the native C BSON decoding extension of the MongoDB Python Driver may allow an unauthenticated party who can supply crafted BSON data to the decoder to cause the application process to terminate. In some configurations, nearby process memory may be included in error messages, which may result in limited unintended disclosure of data.

items.title: CVE-2026-135146
items.summary: An improper certificate revocation check in the MongoDB Python Driver's optional TLS revocation-checking support allows an unauthenticated party that operates the network endpoint a client connects to, and that holds a revoked but still-dated certificate trusted by that client, to have the connection accepted. This may result in unintended disclosure of application credentials and other session data, and in the client treating responses from that endpoint as genuine.

items.title: CVE-2026-136267
items.summary: Improper sanitization of mixed data and markup elements when processing content in Kiro Web before 2026-10-30, in combination with agents running specific models such as DeepSeek v3.2, GLM-5, MiniMax M2.1, MiniMax M2.5, or Qwen3-coder-next, may allow a remote unauthenticated actor to execute arbitrary commands in a subscriber's hosted development environment via crafted content being repeated back to the user by the agent. AWS has addressed this issue. No customer action is required.

items.title: CVE-2026-135224
items.summary: The MongoDB C Driver does not confirm that the party signing a supplied certificate revocation status response is authorized to answer for the certificate being checked. An unauthenticated party that operates the TLS endpoint a client connects to can therefore have a withdrawn certificate accepted. This may result in unintended disclosure of the application's database traffic and in the loss of the revocation decision.

items.title: CVE-2026-135134
items.summary: A NULL pointer dereference and invalid memory release in the server discovery component of the MongoDB C Driver may allow an unauthenticated party that controls a server endpoint, or that can alter unencrypted network traffic, to cause a client application to terminate by sending a crafted discovery response.

items.title: CVE-2026-135150
items.summary: In Eclipse Ditto versions 1.1.0 to 3.9.9, the nginx reverse proxy configurations shipped with Ditto (Helm chart, Docker Compose, Kubernetes and OpenShift deployment files) forward a client-supplied `x-ditto-pre-authenticated` header to the Ditto gateway on locations that do not apply nginx authentication, such as `/api/2/connections`. nginx selects the location based on the normalized request URI but forwards the raw URI, while the gateway does not treat an encoded slash (`%2f`) as a path separator. A crafted request path is therefore routed by nginx through such an unauthenticated location an…

items.title: CVE-2026-80273
items.summary: Dell Secure Connect Gateway (SCG) Virtual Edition, versions prior to 5.36.00.16, contains an Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an OS Command ('OS Command Injection') vulnerability. An attacker with local access to the appliance could potentially exploit this vulnerability, leading to arbitrary command execution and privilege escalation, resulting in complete compromise of confidentiality, integrity, and availability of the appliance.

items.title: CVE-2026-114346
items.summary: The phsuperpack module for PrestaShop is vulnerable to a missing authorization check. The controller at /module/phsuperpack/pack can be accessed without login, which allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to modify the module's data and create, edit, or delete products, including the complete deletion of a product with its translations, shop associations, stock, and images. This issue was fixed in version 3.0.26.

items.title: CVE-2026-136706
items.summary: This vulnerability exists in the DIGIT Platform due to improper neutralization of user supplied input while constructing SQL queries and execution in the affected User and Access Control Service components. An unauthenticated remote attacker could exploit this vulnerability by sending specially crafted input through the affected API endpoint to the targeted system. Successful exploitation of this vulnerability could allow the attacker to execute arbitrary SQL queries, potentially resulting in unauthorized disclosure, modification or deletion of database information on the targeted system.

items.title: CVE-2026-129968
items.summary: LiteSpeed Cache Plugin for Prestashop does not verify authenticity of "pd" parameter and uses it to render a template without checking that it is a real .tpl file. An unauthenticated attacker can send specially crafted requests to a store that cause the server to process attacker-suplied content, potentially giving the attacker full control of the store and access to customer and payment data. This issue was fixed in version 1.6.2.

items.title: CVE-2026-128857
items.summary: The Web To Print Shop : uDraw WordPress plugin through 3.4.0 does not restrict the source URL, destination path or file type when an unauthenticated AJAX action fetches a file and writes it to a web-accessible directory, allowing unauthenticated users to upload executable PHP files and achieve remote code execution, as well as read arbitrary local files.

items.title: CVE-2026-128854
items.summary: The Web To Print Shop : uDraw WordPress plugin through 3.4.0 does not validate URLs taken from the request before fetching them server-side and returning the response, allowing unauthenticated users to make the server request internal resources and read the responses.

items.title: CVE-2026-115280
items.summary: The Print Invoice & Delivery Notes for WooCommerce WordPress plugin before 7.4.0 does not perform authorisation checks when rendering its front-end print document for a reserved order identifier, allowing unauthenticated users to disclose the configured store contact details (including the site administrator's email address) and to create Print Invoice & Delivery Notes for WooCommerce WordPress plugin before 7.4.0 files in arbitrary existing, writable directories outside the Print Invoice & Delivery Notes for WooCommerce WordPress plugin before 7.4.0's own folder.

items.title: CVE-2026-128856
items.summary: The Web To Print Shop : uDraw WordPress plugin through 3.4.0 does not restrict the file paths, extensions or contents written by one of its unauthenticated AJAX actions, allowing unauthenticated users to write arbitrary PHP files to a web-accessible directory and execute code on the server.

items.title: CVE-2026-128855
items.summary: The Web To Print Shop : uDraw WordPress plugin through 3.4.0 does not validate a user-supplied file path before deleting it, allowing unauthenticated users to delete image and PDF files anywhere the web server can write, including the whole media library.

items.title: CVE-2026-128853
items.summary: The Web To Print Shop : uDraw WordPress plugin through 3.4.0 does not sanitise and escape a parameter before using it in a SQL statement, allowing unauthenticated users to perform SQL injection attacks.

items.title: CVE-2026-128852
items.summary: The Web To Print Shop : uDraw WordPress plugin through 3.4.0 does not validate the type or content of files uploaded through several unauthenticated AJAX actions, allowing unauthenticated users to store SVG files containing JavaScript, which are served from the site's own origin and executed in the browser of any user who opens them, such as an administrator.

items.title: CVE-2026-125896
items.summary: The Synoptic Web Designer: best WordPress design tool WordPress plugin through 1.12 does not perform any capability, authentication, or nonce check on an action that is also exposed to unauthenticated visitors, and it builds a database UPDATE statement by concatenating unvalidated request input, allowing unauthenticated attackers to overwrite arbitrary database records, including an administrator's password, and take over the site. This is only exploitable on PHP 7.x.

items.title: Hackers Are Exploiting a Critical Drupal Flaw to Target Websites Without Needing a Password
items.summary: Hackers are exploiting CVE-2026-132165, a critical flaw in Drupal core that can let them take over a website or run code on its server without a password. items.summary: Update: proof of concept on GitHub published. Apache Spark, a widely used open-source data processing framework, is affected when its web UI has access control lists enabled and an authentication filter in use. An attacker could exploit this flaw to run arbitrary operating system commands with the same privileges as the Spark process, potentially taking full control of the affected server.

items.title: CVE-2024-3273: D-Link DNS-320L remote command execution in nas_sharing.cgi (Update: proof of concept on GitHub published)
items.summary: Update: proof of concept on GitHub published. items.title: CVE-2026-136513
items.summary: When Debug or CommLog is enabled and the log directory cannot be used, psqlODBC falls back to a directory under the user's home directory. It wrote that path with an unexpanded ~, which is resolved relative to the process's current directory. Another local user who controls a directory on that path can make the driver create the victim's mylog_*.log and psqlodbc_*.log files in any directory the victim can write to, or leave the victim's process blocked in open(). items.summary: Update: now rated critical. A stack-based buffer overflow vulnerability exists in the login functionality of Disk Pulse Enterprise version 9.0.34. An attacker can send a specially crafted HTTP POST request to the /login endpoint with an overly long username parameter, causing a buffer overflow in the libspp.dll component. Successful exploitation allows arbitrary code execution with SYSTEM privileges.

items.summary: Update: now rated critical. A command injection flaw in the Wavlink AC3000's wireless.cgi component lets an attacker run arbitrary commands on the device by sending a specially crafted HTTP request. The attacker must reach the device over the network and log in with high-level privileges first.

items.title: CVE-2023-5824: Red Hat denial of service in Squid web proxy (Update: now rated critical)
items.summary: Update: now rated critical. Squid, the web proxy shipped in Red Hat Enterprise Linux 8 and several of its update streams, can be made to stall or crash its worker process. An attacker can cause this denial of service remotely, without logging in, when a large cached HTTP response header is read back from disk.

items.title: CVE-2026-1324: Operation and Maintenance Management System command injection in SSH session handling (Update: now rated critical)
items.summary: Update: now rated critical. Sangfor Operation and Maintenance Management System contains an OS command injection flaw in its SSH protocol session handling, where manipulating the keypassword argument lets an attacker run operating system commands. The attack can be launched remotely over the network by someone with low-privilege login access.

items.title: CVE-2022-26019: pfSense CE and pfSense Plus arbitrary command execution via NTP GPS settings (Update: now rated critical)
items.summary: Update: now rated critical. Improper access control in pfSense CE and pfSense Plus lets a remote attacker who already holds the privilege to change NTP GPS settings rewrite existing files on the system, which may lead to arbitrary command execution. The attacker reaches it over the network after logging in with low-level access and needs no action from a user.

items.title: CVE-2022-26151: Command injection in mobile management server (Update: now rated critical)
items.summary: Update: now rated critical. Citrix XenMobile Server has a command injection flaw that lets an attacker insert and run commands on the affected system. An attacker can reach it remotely over the network, but only after logging in with high-level privileges.

items.title: CVE-2023-46846: Squid: request/response smuggling in http/1.1 and icap (Update: now rated critical)
items.summary: Update: now rated critical. Squid, as shipped in several Red Hat Enterprise Linux products, mishandles chunked encoding in HTTP/1.1 and ICAP traffic. A remote attacker can send smuggled requests and responses over the network, without logging in or any user action, to bypass firewall and frontend security systems.

items.title: CVE-2025-34024: Edimax EW-7438RPn Mini OS Command Injection via mp.asp (Update: now rated critical)
items.summary: Update: now rated critical. The Edimax EW-7438RPn Mini firmware has an OS command injection flaw in its mp.asp form handler. A network attacker who has logged in with low privileges can inject shell metacharacters into the command parameter and run arbitrary commands as root.

items.title: CVE-2025-34029: Edimax EW-7438RPn Mini OS Command Injection via syscmd.asp (Update: now rated critical)
items.summary: Update: now rated critical. The Edimax EW-7438RPn Mini firmware has an OS command injection flaw in its syscmd.asp form handler. A remote attacker with a low-privilege login can run arbitrary shell commands as the root user.

items.title: CVE-2026-136835: Jenkins Script Security Plugin sandbox escape in @Builder annotation handling (Update: now rated critical)
items.summary: Update: now rated critical. The Jenkins Script Security Plugin does not reject certain @Builder annotations that name an arbitrary class when the annotation is referred to by a partially qualified name. An attacker who can define and run sandboxed scripts, including Pipelines, can use this to execute code outside the sandbox if a suitable class is on the classpath of the component that evaluates the script.

items.title: CVE-2026-114713: UnrealIRCd remote command injection in labeled-response module (Update: Nuclei template published)
items.summary: Update: Nuclei template published. The labeled-response module in UnrealIRCd 6.0.0 (before the 6.2.7.1 fix) fails to escape the IRCv3 "label" message tag, so any user on a network with two or more linked servers can, remotely and without logging in, inject server-to-server commands that run with server authority. Because the bug requires a network with at least two linked servers, it is not limited to a single standalone server.

items.title: USN-9203-1: libpcap vulnerabilities
items.summary: Jin Wei, Kunwei Qian, and Ping Chen discovered that libpcap did not properly validate the format of MAC addresses passed to the pcap_ether_aton() function, leading to an out-of-bounds read and write. An attacker could possibly use this issue to cause applications using libpcap to crash, resulting in a denial of service, or possibly execute arbitrary code. This issue only affected Ubuntu 22.04 LTS and Ubuntu 24.04 LTS. (CVE-2025-11961) It was discovered that the libpcap remote capture (rpcap) client did not properly validate packet messages received from the server. A malicious server could pos…

items.title: USN-9200-1: elfutils vulnerabilities
items.summary: It was discovered that elfutils incorrectly handled memory when processing certain malformed DWARF data. If a user or automated system were tricked into running readelf on a specially crafted file, an attacker could possibly use this issue to cause readelf to crash, resulting in a denial of service, or execute arbitrary code. (CVE-2025-1352) It was discovered that strip from elfutils could be made to dereference invalid memory when processing certain sections without data. If a user or automated system were tricked into running strip on a specially crafted file, an attacker could possibly use…

items.title: Broadcom patches VMware vCenter auth bypass; CISA adds Drupal, Optimizely flaws to KEV
items.summary: Broadcom patched 23 VMware flaws incl. vCenter auth bypass CVE-2026-123903 (9.8). CISA added Drupal Core, Optimizely and Idunno AntiCsrf to KEV; GreyNoise reports AI-assisted attacks on Check Point servers.

items.title: CVE-2026-123684
items.summary: An improper version validation vulnerability exists in the product update mechanism of StellarProtect Linux and Stellar Agent (Linux). An attacker with product admin privileges can downgrade the product to an older, potentially vulnerable version, potentially allowing previously patched vulnerabilities to be reintroduced and security protections to be weakened. This issue affects StellarProtect Linux: 1.0 and earlier; Stellar Agent (Linux): before 1.2.54. *Note: Stellar Agent (Linux) is the new name for StellarProtect Linux.

items.title: CVE-2026-123689
items.summary: A SQL injection vulnerability exists in the Search Agents API of StellarOne due to improper sanitization of user-supplied input. An authenticated attacker with Viewer privileges can send crafted requests to manipulate backend SQL queries. This issue affects StellarOne: before 5.0.3232.

items.title: CVE-2026-123688
items.summary: An improper authorization vulnerability exists in the patch management functionality of StellarOne. An attacker with Viewer web access can perform administrative patch management operations. This issue affects StellarOne: before 5.0.3232.

items.title: CVE-2026-123679
items.summary: An improper access control vulnerability exists in a privileged Unix domain socket of StellarProtect Linux and Stellar Agent (Linux). Due to insufficient authorization checks, a low-privileged local attacker can interact with the daemon and invoke privileged operations without the necessary permissions. This issue affects StellarProtect Linux: 1.0 and earlier; Stellar Agent (Linux): before 1.2.54. *Note: Stellar Agent (Linux) is the new name for StellarProtect Linux.

items.title: CVE-2026-123687
items.summary: An arbitrary file write vulnerability exists in the patch upload functionality of StellarOne due to improper validation of file paths. An attacker with admin web access can upload a crafted patch package to write arbitrary files on endpoints with the privileges of the endpoint service. This issue affects StellarOne: before 5.0.3232.

items.title: CVE-2026-123686
items.summary: An OS command injection vulnerability exists in the vShell command-line interface of StellarOne due to improper validation of user-supplied input. An authenticated attacker with access to vShell can inject crafted commands to bypass the restricted shell environment and execute arbitrary operating system commands. This issue affects StellarOne: before 5.0.3232.

items.title: CVE-2026-123683
items.summary: A SQL injection vulnerability exists in an Accounts Manager service of StellarOne running inside a container due to improper handling of user-supplied input in SQL queries. An attacker with command execution access to the host system or another container with network connectivity to the affected service can send crafted requests to manipulate backend database queries. This issue affects StellarOne: before 5.0.3232.

items.title: CVE-2026-123681
items.summary: An HTML injection vulnerability exists in the alert notification functionality of StellarOne due to improper sanitization of agent-supplied data. An attacker controlling an agent identity can submit crafted HTML content, potentially allowing the attacker to manipulate displayed content or deceive recipients. This issue affects StellarOne: before 5.0.3232.

items.title: CVE-2026-137046
items.summary: A vulnerability was detected in mahmoudai1 school-management-system up to ecec9faaf2fb1a3c5cd096e063f8ef326d09cdfd. The impacted element is the function userModel::checkUserInDB of the file loginServer.php of the component Login Handler. Performing a manipulation of the argument ID results in sql injection. The attack is possible to be carried out remotely. The exploit is now public and may be used. The project was informed of the problem early through an issue report but has not responded yet.

items.title: CVE-2026-137327
items.summary: GNU mtools through 4.0.50 contains a divide-by-zero vulnerability that allows attackers to crash mtools commands by supplying a FAT image with a zero sectors-per-cluster byte. Attackers can craft a FAT image that, when opened with mdir, minfo or mtype, triggers a SIGFPE in calc_num_clus() on x86, causing denial of service.

items.title: CVE-2026-137326
items.summary: ICU4C through 79.1 contains a use-after-free and double free vulnerability in the x11-compound-text converter because cloning shares the extraInfo block without a safeClone handler. Attackers who control the charset name passed to ucnv_open() in applications calling ucnv_setSubstString() or cloning converters can corrupt the heap, causing crashes and potentially code execution.

items.title: CVE-2026-137043
items.summary: A security vulnerability has been detected in TOTOLINK N350RT 9.3.5u.6468_B20250827/9.3.5u.6466_B20250825. The affected element is the function setLanguageCfg of the file /cgi-bin/cstecgi.cgi. Such manipulation of the argument lang leads to authorization bypass. The attack can be executed remotely. The exploit has been disclosed publicly and may be used.

items.title: CVE-2026-137309
items.summary: Friendica through 2026.05-1 contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability in item_edit() that allows authenticated local users to edit other authors' posts by submitting their own stored copy's post_id. Attackers can POST to /item to delete attachments and overwrite the shared body, title and content warning, which is shown under the original author's name.

items.title: CVE-2026-137308
items.summary: markdownify-mcp before 1.2.0 contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability that allows attackers to bypass URL validation by supplying DNS names, bracketed IPv6 literals, or IPv4-mapped IPv6 addresses. Attackers can influence URLs passed to webpage-to-markdown or git-repo-to-markdown through prompt injection to fetch loopback services, internal hosts, and cloud metadata endpoints.

items.title: CVE-2026-137305
items.summary: Grav Form plugin before 9.2.4 contains a code injection vulnerability that allows page authors to write uploads into Twig template folders by setting an unchecked file field destination in Form::uploadFiles(). Attackers can upload .txt or .svg files containing Twig and have them rendered as trusted templates outside the sandbox, executing code as the web server user.

items.title: CVE-2026-136949
items.summary: A weakness has been identified in nliautaud pico-content-editor up to 02d5ad6c820c5050c542ab9505819b5e0a0ba1af. The affected element is the function getLanguageContent of the file src/EditorsHandlers/ContentTools.php of the component ContentTools Editor. This manipulation of the argument ContentToolsUrl causes server-side request forgery. The attack can be initiated remotely. The exploit has been made available to the public and could be used for attacks. Continious delivery with rolling releases is used by this product. Therefore, no version details of affected nor updated releases are availa…

items.title: CVE-2026-136950
items.summary: A security vulnerability has been detected in Ghostty up to 1.3.1. The impacted element is an unknown function of the component macOS OSC 8 Hyperlink Handler. Such manipulation leads to injection. The attack can be launched remotely. Upgrading to version 1.4.0 is sufficient to resolve this issue. The name of the patch is 54fe8e188552977249a084db687e75aee6bf12e9. Upgrading the affected component is advised.

items.title: CVE-2026-122263
items.summary: Kestra is an open-source control plane for workflows across data, infrastructure, and applications. Prior to version 2.0.1, the namespace-files export endpoint places an unvalidated namespace path segment into the Content-Disposition filename of the ZIP download. An attacker who tricks a user into following a crafted export URL can inject Content-Disposition header parameters to spoof the saved filename or extension. This issue is fixed in version 2.0.1.

items.title: CVE-2026-136946
items.summary: A vulnerability was identified in philipjscott simple-thumbnail up to 1.6.5. This issue affects the function ffmpegExecute of the file index.js. The manipulation of the argument seek leads to os command injection. It is possible to initiate the attack remotely. The exploit is publicly available and might be used. The project was informed of the problem early through an issue report but has not responded yet.

items.title: CVE-2026-136945
items.summary: A vulnerability was determined in FastStone Image Viewer up to 8.5. This vulnerability affects unknown code of the file FSViewer.exe of the component ICO Decoder. Executing a manipulation can lead to out-of-bounds write. The attack may be performed from remote. The exploit has been publicly disclosed and may be utilized. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

items.title: CVE-2026-52803
items.summary: Gogs is an open source self-hosted Git service. Prior to 0.15.0, Gogs does not regenerate the session ID after successful authentication. An attacker who forces a victim to use a known session ID can hijack the session after the victim logs in and take over the account. This issue is fixed in version 0.15.0.

items.summary: Missing Authentication for Critical Function vulnerability in Drupal Drupal core allows Exploiting Incorrectly Configured Access Control Security Levels. This issue affects Drupal core versions: from 0.0.0 to 10.6.22, from 11.0.0 to 11.3.22, from 11.4.0 to 11.4.13.

items.title: CVE-2026-66784
items.summary: A flaw was found in Submariner. In its default Pre-Shared Key (PSK) mode, all gateways within a broker set utilize the same PSK. An attacker, by knowing this shared PSK, can forge an Endpoint Custom Resource (CR) to impersonate another cluster's identity. This enables the attacker to establish an Internet Protocol Security (IPsec) tunnel under the false identity, leading to a Man-in-the-Middle (MITM) attack on network traffic between clusters.

items.title: CVE-2026-133210
items.summary: In Revive Adserver through 6.0.9, the zone banner-linking page (zone-include.php) does not cast the keys of the includebanner request array to integers. An authenticated manager, or a trafficker with the zone-linking permission, who owns the submitted website and zone can place SQL in an array key, which is concatenated unquoted into the banner-lookup query, resulting in time-based blind SQL injection bounded by the privileges of the application's database account.

items.title: CVE-2026-133209
items.summary: In Revive Adserver through 6.0.9, deleting an agency, advertiser, or publisher through affected API paths can leave the associated account and user session active because the deletion path does not load the entity's account identifier before cleanup. A user whose entity has been deleted can continue accessing pages of the orphaned account. Access to data belonging to another agency was not demonstrated.

items.title: CVE-2026-133207
items.summary: In Revive Adserver through 6.0.9, user-controlled entity names in XLS report exports can be interpreted as spreadsheet formulas. A user with permission to rename a zone can place a formula in the zone name, which is then included in another user's Conversion Tracking report. Opening the affected spreadsheet can evaluate the formula and alter displayed report contents.

items.title: CVE-2026-133206
items.summary: In Revive Adserver through 6.0.9, an advertiser can put XML syntax in fields of its own video creative. Unescaped MediaFile attributes and CDATA terminators allow the advertiser to inject elements into VAST responses served for a publisher's zone. A crafted TrackingEvents block can suppress the ad server's video playback event records and redirect tracking requests to an attacker-controlled endpoint.

items.title: CVE-2026-133205
items.summary: In Revive Adserver through 6.0.9, an authenticated manager can supply another agency's advertiser or website identifier as a report scope and obtain that entity's name in an XLS report header. Submitted scope identifiers are not checked against the manager's permitted selections. The demonstrated disclosure is limited to entity names.

items.title: CVE-2026-95798
items.summary: Missing integrity verification vulnerabilities exist in the command line interface of HPE Networking Management Software (Airwave) that could be exploited by a low-privileged local attacker if certain preconditions outside of the attacker's control are met. Successful exploitation could allow an attacker to modify certain system data.

items.title: CVE-2026-95797
items.summary: A weak cryptography vulnerability exists in HPE Networking Management Software (Airwave). Successful exploitation could allow an authenticated remote attacker with high privileges to obtain sensitive information from the affected system if certain preconditions outside of the attacker's control are met.

items.title: CVE-2026-95795
items.summary: Missing authorization vulnerabilities exist in the API of HPE Networking Management Software (Airwave). Successful exploitation could allow an authenticated attacker with low privileges to modify data on the affected system.

items.title: CVE-2026-95794
items.summary: An XML external entity (XXE) vulnerability exists in the web-based management interface of HPE Networking Management Software (Airwave). Successful exploitation could allow an authenticated remote attacker with low privileges to obtain sensitive information from the affected system.

items.title: CVE-2026-133980
items.summary: Path traversal vulnerabilities exist in the web-based management interface and API of HPE Networking Management Software (Airwave), which could be exploited by an authenticated attacker with low privileges. Successful exploitation could allow an attacker to read certain files on the underlying operating system.

items.title: CVE-2026-133978
items.summary: A command injection vulnerability exists in the web-based management interface of HPE Networking Management Software (Airwave). Successful exploitation could allow an authenticated remote attacker with low privileges to execute arbitrary commands on the underlying operating system if certain preconditions outside of the attacker's control are met.

items.title: CVE-2026-133976

items.title: CVE-2026-71296
items.summary: A flaw was found in maestro. A remote attacker could exploit a misconfiguration in the gRPC server where authentication defaults to a 'mock' mode. This default setting bypasses all authentication and authorization, allowing an unauthorized attacker to write resource bundles. Consequently, this could lead to arbitrary code execution on managed clusters.

items.title: CVE-2026-137079
items.summary: libvorbis through 1.3.7 contains a stack buffer overflow vulnerability in _ov_getlap() in lib/vorbisfile.c that passes a negative sample count from vorbis_synthesis_lapout() to memcpy(). Attackers can supply a short, valid Ogg Vorbis file with suitable block sizes to overwrite stack frames and crash applications performing two consecutive lapped seeks.

items.title: CVE-2026-137063
items.summary: Leptonica 1.79.0 through 1.87.0 contains a heap-based buffer overflow vulnerability in l_byteaInitFromStream() that allows attackers to write past a heap buffer by supplying oversized input. Attackers can provide a file larger than 1,000,000,000 bytes, causing l_byteaCreate() to allocate a 201-byte buffer before memcpy copies the full stream size, crashing the application.

items.title: CVE-2026-136831
items.summary: A vulnerability was determined in WPExperts New User Approve Plugin up to 3.3 on WordPress. Impacted is the function update_user_role of the file includes/end-points/class-users-api.php of the component REST API. Executing a manipulation can lead to missing authorization. It is possible to launch the attack remotely. The exploit has been publicly disclosed and may be utilized. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

items.title: CVE-2026-137089
items.summary: merge-deep-composed through 0.1.4 contains a prototype pollution vulnerability in _mergeDeepOne() that allows remote attackers to modify Object.prototype by supplying __proto__ keys. Attackers can pass JSON-parsed input containing __proto__ as a merge source to inject inherited properties, causing logic bypass or denial of service in Node.js processes.

items.title: CVE-2026-137062
items.summary: BookStack before 26.09.3 contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability that allows authenticated Editors to permanently delete recycle bin content by converting chapters to books or books to shelves. Attackers can trigger TrashCan::destroyEntity() through the conversion actions to force-delete soft-deleted children, revisions and attachments, including content deleted by other users, preventing restoration.

items.title: CVE-2026-137061
items.summary: Wallos before 5.11.2 contains an infinite loop vulnerability that allows authenticated users or API key holders to exhaust server resources by storing subscriptions with a frequency of 0. Attackers can trigger renew.php or get_monthly_cost.php to loop forever on a P0D interval, pinning PHP workers and hanging the next-payment cron job for all users.

items.title: CVE-2026-133445
items.summary: In gdm3 before 51.2, an improper privilege management vulnerability allows an unprivileged local attacker with an active GDM graphical session to execute arbitrary code as root by supplying a malicious environment variable during session reauthentication.

items.title: CVE-2026-136822
items.summary: A vulnerability has been found in D-Link R32 1.10B02. The impacted element is the function SetDeviceSettings of the file /usr/bin/httpd of the component DHMAPI Action Handler. Such manipulation of the argument TZLocation leads to os command injection. It is possible to launch the attack remotely. The exploit has been disclosed to the public and may be used.

items.title: CVE-2026-17194
items.summary: GitLab has remediated an issue in GitLab CE/EE affecting all versions from 16.7.0 before 19.4.11, 19.5 before 19.5.9, and 19.6 before 19.6.2 that under certain conditions could have allowed an authenticated user with developer-role permissions to merge code changes into protected branches without triggering approval resets due to the use of a weak hash function in the merge request approval change detection mechanism.

items.title: CVE-2026-135487
items.summary: Munshi (by Petpooja) before 2026-07-15 contained a stored HTML injection vulnerability that allows authenticated users to store markup in the profile full_name field by submitting a modified request directly to the backend, which persists the value without sanitization. The Contact Support workflow later inserts the stored name into the generated support email without HTML encoding, so attackers can make injected HTML and media, such as misleading banners, masked hyperlinks and external tracking resources, render in support messages received by the support team.
